company.name: Genecis
company.shortDescription: Genecis is an early-stage organic waste processing startup that uses biotechnology to convert waste into high-value materials.
company.description: Genecis is an early-stage organic waste processing startup that uses biotechnology to convert waste into biodegradable plastics and other high-value materials. It converts organic waste into PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoate), a biodegradable, compostable, and non-toxic polymer that can be tuned to replace a wide variety of traditional plastics. PHA can be used for single-use plastics, clothing and textiles, automotive interiors, medical tools and products, and food contact applications.

productsAndServices.description: Genecis produces PHA plastics from organic waste, offering a biodegradable alternative to traditional plastics for use in packaging, textiles, automotive parts, and medical equipment.
productsAndServices.name: PHA Plastics

productsAndServices.description: Genecis offers custom PHA polymer formulation services, tailoring the biodegradability, functionality, and quality of PHA plastics to meet specific partner product requirements.
productsAndServices.name: Custom PHA Polymer Formulation

productsAndServices.description: The company collaborates with partners to develop new products made from PHA, ensuring these meet sustainability goals and are ready for commercialization.
productsAndServices.name: PHA-based Product Development
